title: Four City Nocturnes
identity: Carlos Micháns, Four City Nocturnes (2012), a four-movement work for tenor saxophone and piano: Jaén: Night Heat; Chidambaram: Broken Midnight Song; New York: Evening Rush; Paris: Before Dawn.

evidence.claim: Donemus identifies the work, tenor saxophone and piano scoring, and lists it among the composer’s chamber works.
McGill University’s 2025 Bachelor recital program lists the work for tenor saxophone and piano and names its four movements.
The 2018 NASA conference program includes it in a saxophone recital.
